bio: Prof. Dr. Tahar Abbou is a Full Professor of African Civilization at Ahmed Draia University of Adrar, Algeria. He holds a Ph.D. in African Civilization and has dedicated over two decades to researching West African medieval empires, trans-Saharan cultural and commercial linkages, colonial socioeconomic history, and Saharan manuscript traditions. A Lifetime Member of the West African Research Association (WARA) at Boston University, Dr. Abbou is also a prominent researcher at the Platform of Algerian Manuscripts in Africa (PAM) and serves as the Director of the Intensive Language Center (CEIL) at the University of Adrar.
